 Bardic Inspiration is a class-specific resource for Bards.

Overview

Bardic Inspiration enables bards to use the  Bardic Inspiration class action and subclass specific abilities. They, like all resources, are displayed above a character's hotbar next to their other resources such as  Actions,  Bonus Actions, and Spell Slots.

Many actions using Bardic Inspiration involve a dice roll using a character's bardic inspiration die. By default at bard level 1 1d6 die is used, this is increased at bard level 5 to 1d8, and finally at bard level 10 to 1d10.

Gaining Bardic Inspiration

Bardic Inspiration is granted to the Bard Class starting at level 1 with 3 charges, increasing up to 5 as you level up.

Additionally, a limited Bardic Inspiration can be gained from  Alfira near the end of Act Two. This version can only be used with the default  Bardic Inspiration class action, but grants its bonuses as a 1d12 boost instead of using the character's bardic die. It is recovered on a long rest.

Recovering Bardic Inspiration

By default Bardic Inspiration is recovered every Long Rest.

The passive feature  Font of Inspiration, granted to Bards at level 5, recovers used Bardic Inspirations on a Short Rest.

Items

The following items restore Bardic Inspiration:

  • Boots of Brilliance

The following items are related to Bardic Inspiration or actions which use them:

  • Cap of Curing
  • Blazer of Benevolence
  • Wondrous Gloves
